description: Return top SwitchWize rates with freshness and attribution. Savings, CDs, checking and money market answer only from their editor-approved snapshot. A category with no approved release yet returns no ranked rates and says so (approval_status: not_yet_approved) rather than serving unverified observations; approvedOnly makes that requirement explicit. Approved responses include product terms and field evidence; stale or unavailable releases return no ranked rates.

approvedOnly.description: Require an editor-approved deposit snapshot. Savings, CDs, checking and money market always answer from their own approved release; a category with no release yet returns no ranked rates (approval_status: not_yet_approved), as do stale or unavailable releases.

category.description: Rate category, e.g. savings, cds, money-market, checking, mortgage.

name: get_top_rates
title: Top Rates
